objective: Definir el contrato puro de tarifa historica, descuentos, bonificaciones, cortesias y autorizaciones para Cavas, sin DDL ni contabilidad paralela. Debe preservar precio normal, precio autorizado, delta economico, solicitante, aprobador/rechazador, motivo, vigencia y evidencia. Las decisiones rechazadas tambien deben conservarse. No hardcodear porcentajes, montos ni roles concretos de aprobacion; la autorizacion se resuelve por politica/RBAC externa al contrato.

import pytest

from modules.cava_socios.domain import (
    HistoricalTariffSnapshot,
    PricingAdjustmentKind,
    PricingDecisionStatus,
    PricingExceptionDecision,
    pricing_foregone_revenue,
    validate_historical_tariff_snapshot,
    validate_pricing_exception_decision,
)


def test_historical_tariff_snapshot_preserves_period_price():
    snapshot = HistoricalTariffSnapshot(
        tariff_snapshot_id="TAR-1", contract_period_id="PER-1",
        classification_reference="FUNDADOR", normal_amount=12000,
        currency_code="MXN", effective_from="2026-01-01",
    )
    validate_historical_tariff_snapshot(snapshot)


def test_requested_exception_has_no_fake_approval():
    decision = PricingExceptionDecision(
        decision_id="DEC-1", tariff_snapshot_id="TAR-1",
        adjustment_kind=PricingAdjustmentKind.DESCUENTO,
        status=PricingDecisionStatus.SOLICITADA, requested_by_user_id="USR-1",
        requested_amount=10000, normal_amount=12000,
    )
    validate_pricing_exception_decision(decision)
    assert pricing_foregone_revenue(decision) == 0.0


def test_approved_exception_requires_actor_reason_and_amount():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        validate_pricing_exception_decision(PricingExceptionDecision(
            decision_id="DEC-2", tariff_snapshot_id="TAR-1",
            adjustment_kind=PricingAdjustmentKind.CORTESIA,
            status=PricingDecisionStatus.APROBADA, requested_by_user_id="USR-1",
            requested_amount=0, normal_amount=12000,
        ))
    decision = PricingExceptionDecision(
        decision_id="DEC-2", tariff_snapshot_id="TAR-1",
        adjustment_kind=PricingAdjustmentKind.CORTESIA,
        status=PricingDecisionStatus.APROBADA, requested_by_user_id="USR-1",
        requested_amount=0, normal_amount=12000, authorized_amount=0,
        decided_by_user_id="DIR-1", reason="Autorizacion comercial documentada",
        evidence_reference="EVID-1",
    )
    validate_pricing_exception_decision(decision)
    assert pricing_foregone_revenue(decision) == 12000.0


def test_rejected_exception_is_preserved_but_has_no_authorized_amount():
    decision = PricingExceptionDecision(
        decision_id="DEC-3", tariff_snapshot_id="TAR-1",
        adjustment_kind=PricingAdjustmentKind.BONIFICACION,
        status=PricingDecisionStatus.RECHAZADA, requested_by_user_id="USR-1",
        requested_amount=8000, normal_amount=12000, decided_by_user_id="DIR-1",
        reason="No autorizada", evidence_reference="EVID-2",
    )
    validate_pricing_exception_decision(decision)
    assert pricing_foregone_revenue(decision) == 0.0


def test_domain_does_not_hardcode_approval_role_or_percentage():
    fields = PricingExceptionDecision.__dataclass_fields__
    assert "approval_role" not in fields
    assert "discount_percent" not in fields
